cases.label: bmopf_native_start_max40
cases.qualification: BMOPFTools native initialization point was unavailable for these staged contexts; this is an unavailable-start result, not a solver failure.

cases.label: bmopf_generated_start_max40
cases.qualification: The standard BMOPFTools build has partial generated starts; this policy explicitly completes those starts with zero for missing coordinates. It is a reproducible mixed-start control, not an independently complete native point.

cases.label: zero_start_max40
cases.qualification: Zero starts are a deliberately adversarial initialization control; the resulting KKT records are diagnostic and not endpoint evidence.

interpretation.completed_start: The completed start retains the baseline 6/6 local solves and 2/6 strict KKT result.
interpretation.native_start: The native BMOPFTools point is unavailable in this staged lifecycle, so it cannot serve as an independent comparison without a separate start-capture path.
interpretation.generated_start: Explicit completion of BMOPFTools' partial generated starts reproduces the completed-start result: 6/6 local solves, 2/6 strict KKT acceptance, and the same complementarity floor.
interpretation.zero_start: All six zero-start runs hit ITERATION_LIMIT and the maximum complementarity residual becomes approximately 2.46e11.
interpretation.conclusion: Initialization materially controls solver completion, but this matrix does not establish that initialization causes the ibr_p_upper floor at a qualified endpoint.
interpretation.next_investigation: Add a captured complete native-start path or per-snapshot solver traces before making a causal convergence claim.
